# linear_document (Resource)

A Linear document whose complete Markdown content is managed by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "linear_document" "example" {
  title      = "Engineering handbook"
  project_id = "ecb63be7-63fb-47fe-95fc-1585d24e172d"

  # Terraform owns the complete Markdown body. For larger documents, use file("${path.module}/document.md").
  content = <<-EOT
    # Engineering handbook

    This document is managed by Terraform.
  EOT

  # Destroying this resource moves the document to Linear's trash.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Complete document content in Markdown. Content must be non-empty.
- `title` (String) Title of the document. An empty string creates an untitled document.

### Optional

- `issue_id` (String) Identifier or issue key, such as `LIN-123`, of the issue that owns the document. Exactly one parent identifier must be configured.
- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project that owns the document. Exactly one parent identifier must be configured.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the document.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import linear_document.example 53c7964a-5bd4-4679-8cca-a5b78498b2b3
```
